svg.text: STAGE 447 · TOPIC 87 · SVG 91 · 🎉 HISTORIC 450-DIMENSION MILESTONE (P887–P888)
Enterprise SIP RFC 6026 Accepted State (Timer L/M) & RFC 4320 Non-INVITE Storm Guard
Eliminating Parallel-Forking 200 OK Zombie AI Dialogs & Multi-Hop Non-INVITE Late-Response 408 Storms
🎉 450 EVALUATION DIMENSIONS
897 Guards · 906 Probes
❌ Legacy RFC 3261 Failure: 0ms 2xx Self-Destruct & 408 Storm
1. INVITE 2xx Immediate Terminated State (Zombie Forked AI Calls)
• T=45ms: AI-Node-A returns 200 OK (tagA) → ICT immediately self-destructs!
• T=48ms: Parallel-forked AI-Node-B returns 200 OK (tagB) racing with CANCEL.
• Orphaned 200 OK has no ICT: either leaks to TU (dual-AI talk-over) or
retransmits for 64*T1 (32,000ms), locking 96+ GPU & RTP ports in cluster!
Result: Unacknowledged Forked 2xx Zombie Dialogs & Spoofed 2xx Hijack
2. Non-INVITE (BYE / INFO / OPTIONS) Synthetic 408 Late-Response Storm
• Legacy proxy sends 100 Trying at Timer E2 (4s) & synthetic 408 at Timer F.
• Upstream UAC receives 408 Request Timeout and deletes NIT transaction.
• Slow downstream gateway emits late 200 OK at T=33s → proxies with no
transaction state blindly forward orphaned 200 OK along Via headers!
Result: Multi-Hop Late-Response Signaling Storm Across SBC Mesh
✅ RFC 6026 Accepted State (P887) & RFC 4320 Storm Guard (P888)
P887 · RFC 6026 Accepted State (Timer L/M) & Forked 2xx ACK+BYE
• Mandatory Accepted State: ICT (Timer M) & IST (Timer L) stay alive for
[16,000, 64,000]ms (nominal 64*T1 = 32,000ms) after first 2xx.
• Secondary Forked 200 OK (distinct To-tag): automatically sends ACK +
immediate BYE ("Call completed elsewhere") freeing AI node in 5ms!
clampedUnackedForked2xxZombieDialogs = 0 · Timer M/L ∈ [16000, 64000]ms
P888 · RFC 4320 Non-INVITE 408/100 Suppression & Timer F/K Guard
• Zero 100 Trying on NIT: forbids 100 Trying on BYE / INFO / OPTIONS.
• Zero Proxy Synthetic 408 Forwarding: silent blackhole on Timer F expiry
instead of forwarding synthetic 408 Request Timeout upstream.
• Clamps Non-INVITE Timer F to [4,000, 32,000]ms + Timer K (5s) absorption.
clampedLateResponseStormOrSynthetic408Packets = 0 · Timer F ∈ [4000, 32000]ms
